title: Sectionwise open direct-image isomorphism
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $V\subset Y$ an open, with $U=f^{-1}V$ and $f_0:U\to V$. For the module direct-image functors $F=f_*$, $F_0=f_{0*}$ [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] and exact open restriction $r_X,r_Y$ [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], construct $e:F\mathbin{\star}r_Y\cong r_X\mathbin{\star}F_0$. Here star means functor sequencing. Its sections are the canonical identification on the same inverse-image open. This is the underived isomorphism used in [def-pc-n3-open-base-change-comparisons].
